104 NN ;; Heading.
106-108 EX [x.git-report]

C gov015.completion-not-request OL GOV-015 MUST_NOT ;; Completing an implementation is not a request to commit, push, merge or rewrite history. ;; = ;; none ;;
C gov019.never-discard OL GOV-019 MUST_NOT ;; Never discard, overwrite, reset, clean or otherwise destroy user work to make a Git operation easier. ;; = ;; none ;;
C gov020.inspect-minimal OL GOV-020 MUST ;; Before a repository-changing operation inspect state (git status, git diff, git diff --cached) and use the minimum operation; do not silently clean unrelated changes. ;; = ;; none ;;
C wf022.staged-scope OL WF-022 MUST ;; Before committing inspect the staged diff and include only the intended logical change; do not stage unrelated modified files. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.git-branch-naming EX GOV-016 DEFAULT ;; Follow the repository's branch-naming convention; otherwise use prefixes like feature/, fix/, refactor/, test/, docs/, chore/ with meaningful names; do not rename existing user branches to satisfy the convention. ;; = ;; Existing repository convention. ;; Branch-naming convention not in the oracle.
C x.git-one-branch-one-worktree EX GOV-016 MUST_NOT ;; One branch must not be checked out simultaneously in multiple normal worktrees. ;; = ;; none ;; Worktree constraint not stated in GOV-016.
C gov016.worktree-focused OL GOV-016 MUST ;; Keep each worktree focused on its branch's concern. ;; = ;; none ;;
C gov019.worktree-removal OL GOV-019,GOV-020 MUST_NOT ;; Before removing a worktree verify changes are committed or preserved; never remove a worktree containing uncommitted user work. ;; = ;; none ;;
C wf022.commit-focus OL WF-022 MUST_NOT ;; Do not combine unrelated fixes or refactors into one commit. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.git-commit-granularity EX WF-022 PREFER ;; Prefer one logical change per commit with implementation and its protecting tests together; no artificial tiny commits. ;; = ;; none ;; Commit granularity preferences beyond WF-022.
C x.git-commit-messages EX - DEFAULT ;; Follow the repository commit-message convention, else Conventional Commits; use the body for important motivation/constraints/migration info and do not narrate obvious diff details. ;; = ;; Existing repository convention. ;; Commit-message convention not in the oracle.
C gov020.pre-push OL GOV-020,WF-022 MUST ;; Before pushing confirm the intended branch, understand working/staged state and avoid pushing unrelated local commits. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.git-verify-before-push EX WF-003 MUST ;; Ensure relevant verification has completed before pushing. ;; = ;; none ;; Pre-push verification gate not in the oracle (WF-003 gates completion claims, not pushes).
C gov015.force-push-explicit OL GOV-015 MUST_NOT ;; Never force-push a shared branch unless the user explicitly requests history rewriting and the consequences are understood. ;; = ;; Explicit request with understood consequences. ;;
C x.git-protected-branches EX GOV-015 MUST_NOT ;; Treat main, master and other protected or shared branches as non-rewritable. ;; = ;; none ;; Absolute protection of main/master/shared branches exceeds GOV-015 (which allows rewriting on explicit request).
C gov019.merge-no-discard OL GOV-019,GOV-020 MUST_NOT ;; Before merge/rebase inspect local uncommitted work and do not automatically stash, reset or discard work to make it proceed. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.git-merge-practice EX GOV-015 MUST ;; Follow repository/team convention or explicit request for merge vs rebase; resolve conflicts from the intended combined behaviour (not mechanical ours/theirs) and run relevant verification afterwards. ;; = ;; none ;; Merge/rebase practice beyond the oracle.
C x.git-pr EX WF-003,WF-022 MUST ;; Run verify before preparing a PR; a PR has a focused purpose and a description explaining what changed, why, how verified and compatibility/migration notes. ;; = ;; none ;; PR preparation rules not in the oracle.
C wf009.pr-honest OL WF-009 MUST_NOT ;; Do not claim checks were run if they were not. ;; = ;; none ;;
C gov020.destructive-inspect OL GOV-020,GOV-019 MUST ;; Treat reset --hard, clean, force pushes, branch deletion and shared-history rebase as high-risk and inspect what will be lost or rewritten before executing them. ;; = ;; none ;;
C u.git-destructive-approved-workflow LU GOV-015 ALLOWED ;; Destructive Git operations may be performed when explicitly requested or clearly required by an approved workflow. ;; = ;; Approved workflow requirement. ;; Open question: does 'clearly required by an approved workflow' relax GOV-015 (which permits repository-changing Git operations only when explicitly requested), or is an approved workflow itself an explicit request?
C x.git-report EX WF-009 ALLOWED ;; After Git operations report resulting state when useful (branch, commit, push target, PR status, remaining uncommitted changes). ;; = ;; Discretionary ('when useful'). ;; Reporting practice beyond the oracle.
